//MetaIntegration: AppId, AppSecret, WebhookVerifyToken and OAuthCallbackUrl are secrets and are deliberately absent here. Supply them through user-secrets or environment variables (MetaIntegration__AppSecret and so on). Without them the integration is switched off and the rest of DAMS is unaffected.

MetaIntegration.//FrontendReturnUrl: Absent here on purpose — like AppSecret, a per-environment value, not a shared default. Without it the OAuth callback falls back to the relative path /crm/settings, which only reaches the CRM if the frontend and this API share a host. If they do not, set an absolute URL (https://your-frontend/crm/settings) via environment/user-secrets before connecting a real Meta account.
MetaIntegration.//LoginConfigId: Absent here on purpose — per environment. Set it to the Facebook Login for Business configuration ID when the Meta app is a Business app; Connect then sends config_id instead of scope. Leave it unset for the classic scope-based dialog. See docs/meta-integration-setup.md.
